tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location 'c:\Users\LENOVO\OneDrive\ドキュメント\CRM'; $content = \"import { User } from '../models/User.js'`n`n// Get all Users`nexport const getUsers = async (req, res) => {`n    const users = await User.find();`n    res.json(users);`n}`n`n// create user `nexport const createUser = async (req, res) => {`n    const user = await User.create(req.body);`n    res.json(user);`n};`n`n// update user `nexport const updatedUser = async (req, res) => {`n    const user = await User.findByIdAndUpdate(req.params.id, req.body, {`n        returnDocument: 'after',`n        runValidators: true,`n    });`n    res.json(user);`n}`n`n// delete User`nexport const deleteUser = async (req, res) => {`n    await User.findByIdAndDelete(req.params.id);`n    res.json({ message: 'User deleted successfully' });`n}`n`n//get user profile`nexport const getUserProfile = async (req, res) => {`n    try {`n        const user = await User.findById(req.user.id).select('-password');`n        res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: user });`n    } catch (error) {`n        res.status(500).json({ success: false, message: 'Server Error' });`n    }`n};`n`n// update user profile`nexport const updateUserProfile = async (req, res) => {`n    try {`n        const updateUser = await User.findByIdAndUpdate(req.user.id, req.body, { returnDocument: 'after', runValidators: true }).select('-password');`n        res.status(200).json({ success: true, data: updateUser });`n    } catch (error) {`n        res.status(500).json({ success: false, message: 'Server Error' });`n    }`n}`n\"; Set-Content -LiteralPath 'Backend/src/controllers/customerController.js' -Value $content -Encoding utf8"
